title: About Kitchen & Flooring Depot
headline: Your home. Your style. Our expertise.
body: Kitchen & Flooring Depot helps Newington, CT homeowners with everything for a new kitchen or bath. Whether it’s new cabinets or countertops, bathrooms, or kitchens, you can enhance your look with a wide array of options from our flooring, cabinet, and countertop store — serving the area for years.

Our dedication to innovative design, extraordinary quality, and superior service creates a truly exceptional experience from start to finish. Visit our showroom at 2434 Berlin Turnpike #7, Newington, CT, or call for a free in-store estimate.

We are a locally owned and operated family business. We keep overhead costs low and pass those savings on to you, with American-made cabinets that are fully assembled and ready to deliver within three working days when available.
